# EDA

```{r}
ggplot(rootData, aes(x = side, y = Length, fill = side)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Genotype) +
  labs(title = "Cell Length Distribution by Inner vs Outer",
       y = "Cell Length") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
rootData_WT <- rootData |> filter(Genotype == "WT")

ggplot(rootData_WT, aes(x = Midline, y = Length, 
                        color = side, group = interaction(root, side))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ root, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Cell Length Along Midline – Wild Type Roots",
    x = "Distance Along Midline",
    y = "Cell Length",
    color = "Side"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

Logistic

```{r}
logis_smooth <- function(df) {
  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(x = Midline, y = Length, color = side, group = interaction(root, side))
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "nls",
      formula = y ~ SSlogis(x, Asym, xmid, scal),
      method.args = list(control = nls.control(maxiter = 200, warnOnly = TRUE)),
      se = FALSE,
      size = 0.8
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ root, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = "Distance Along Midline",
      y = "Cell Length",
      color = "Side"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

# Wild type
logis_smooth(rootData_WT) + ggtitle("WT: Inner vs Outer Logistic Fits for Each Root")

# Mutant
logis_smooth(rootData_MU) + ggtitle("MU: Inner vs Outer Logistic Fits for Each Root")
```

# Frequentist Model

### Fit nls with customized function

$$
\text{Length ~} A+\frac{(B-A)}{1+e^{((x_{mid} + \beta * \text{side_ind} - x)/\text{scal})}}
$$

```{r}
# Define restricted logistic with fixed A and B
fpl_restricted <- function(x, xmid, scal, beta, side_ind, A, B){
  xmid_eff <- xmid + beta * side_ind
  A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((xmid_eff - x) / scal))
}

# Set fixed asymptotes:
A_fixed <- 7     # based on biological start length
B_fixed <- 35    # based on WT observed upper range (adjust if needed)
```

```{r}
WT_model_output <- list()

for(root_num in unique(rootData_WT$root)){
  curr_root <- rootData_WT |> filter(root == root_num)
  curr_root$side_ind <- ifelse(curr_root$side == "Outer", 1, 0)

  # Starting values:
  start_vals <- list(
    xmid = median(curr_root$Midline),
    scal = diff(range(curr_root$Midline)) / 4,
    beta = -30   # negative means outer shifts earlier
  )

  fit <- try(
    nls(
      Length ~ fpl_restricted(Midline, xmid, scal, beta, side_ind, A = A_fixed, B = B_fixed),
      data = curr_root,
      start = start_vals,
      control = nls.control(maxiter = 200, warnOnly = TRUE)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    WT_model_output[[paste0("root_", root_num)]] <- fit
  } else {
    message(paste("Model failed for root", root_num))
  }
}
```

```{r}
summary(WT_model_output[[1]])
```

```{r}
library(broom)
library(knitr)

WT_results <- data.frame(
  root = character(),
  xmid = numeric(),
  scal = numeric(),
  beta = numeric(),
  beta_p = numeric(),
  beta_sig = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(name in names(WT_model_output)){
  model <- WT_model_output[[name]]
  
  coef_info <- tidy(model)
  beta_row <- coef_info[coef_info$term == "beta", ]

  WT_results <- rbind(
    WT_results,
    data.frame(
      root = name,
      xmid = coef(model)["xmid"],
      scal = coef(model)["scal"],
      beta = coef(model)["beta"],
      beta_p = beta_row$p.value,
      beta_sig = ifelse(beta_row$p.value < 0.05, "*", "ns")
    )
  )
}

kable(WT_results, digits = 5, caption = "Wild Type Logistic Model Results")
```

```{r}
MU_model_output <- list()

for(root_num in unique(rootData_MU$root)){
  curr_root <- rootData_MU |> filter(root == root_num)
  curr_root$side_ind <- ifelse(curr_root$side == "Outer", 1, 0)

  start_vals <- list(
    xmid = median(curr_root$Midline),
    scal = diff(range(curr_root$Midline)) / 4,
    beta = 0   # no shift expected in mutant
  )

  fit <- try(
    nls(
      Length ~ fpl_restricted(Midline, xmid, scal, beta, side_ind, A = A_fixed, B = B_fixed),
      data = curr_root,
      start = start_vals,
      control = nls.control(maxiter = 200, warnOnly = TRUE)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    MU_model_output[[paste0("root_", root_num)]] <- fit
  } else {
    message(paste("Model failed for root", root_num))
  }
}
```

